components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneDigits"
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email"
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:

## Summary

I implemented the household-duplicate rule for owner creation: creating an owner is rejected with **409 Conflict** when another owner has the same `lastName` and `address` (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace), unless the request sets `sharesHousehold: true`.

I mirrored the existing `DuplicateTelephoneException` pattern rather than inventing a new mechanism, and put each piece where it belongs:

- **`openapi.yml`** — added a write-only `sharesHousehold` boolean (default `false`) to the `OwnerFields` schema so the generated `OwnerFieldsDto` can carry the request flag.
- **`util/TextNormalizer.java`** (new) — a small, single-purpose util that canonicalizes text for comparison (trim, collapse whitespace runs, lower-case). Sits alongside the existing `EmailNormalizer`/`TelephoneNormalizer`.
- **`service/DuplicateHouseholdException.java`** (new) — conflict signal, mirroring `DuplicateTelephoneException`.
- **`rest/advice/ExceptionControllerAdvice.java`** — a handler mapping the new exception to 409 (RFC-7807 `ProblemDetail`), matching the telephone handler.
- **`repository/OwnerRepository.java`** + all three impls (`springdatajpa`, `jdbc`, `jpa`) — added `findByLastNameIgnoreCase` to fetch the candidate owners for the check.
- **`service/ClinicService(Impl)`** — extracted owner-creation logic into a dedicated `createOwner(Owner, boolean sharesHousehold)` method (telephone-dup, the new household-dup check, registration-date default, customer-code), leaving `saveOwner` as the plain update-path save. Whitespace/case normalization is compared in Java (via `TextNormalizer`) so the rule behaves identically across all persistence profiles.
- **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — reads the flag and calls `createOwner`.

Design notes: the check loads only same-last-name candidates (indexed lookup) and normalizes addresses in Java, since collapsing arbitrary whitespace runs isn't portable across the JPA/JDBC SQL dialects. Stored address/last-name values are left untouched (normalization is comparison-only), so responses still echo exactly what clients send.
